title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 15 East Market Street in Leesburg, Virginia, as the Norman Duncan Post Office Building.
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 15 East Market Street in Leesburg, Virginia, as the "Norman Duncan Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Congress renamed a Postal Service building in Leesburg, Virginia, after Norman Duncan.
summary.what_it_does: This law gives the post office at 15 East Market Street in Leesburg, Virginia, the official name the Norman Duncan Post Office Building. It is a naming change only. It does not change postal services, rules, or staffing at the site.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 21, 2020, and the name took effect on that date.
